newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close higher in mixed trade.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close higher in mixed trade.

text.p: Sweden's stockmarket edged to a higher close on Monday in mixed but light volumes, with trade dampened by jitters ahead of the U.S. election.
The Stockholm general index nudged up 0.09 percent to 2,123.14, aided by a higher open on Wall Street in afternoon trade. Shares worth 2.3 billion crowns changed hands.
"Everyone is watching the (nine month) reports come in and most of them are lower than the analysts forecast," said one broker. "It has reduced activity on the bourse."
The main focus was drug major Astra's report that showed an eight percent lift in pre-tax profit to 9.85 billion crowns.
This was in line with market expectations and Astra closed unchanged at 302 crowns.

Gas company AGA closed 2.5 crowns lower at 103 crowns after posting a 14 percent fall in profits after financial items to 1.38 billion crowns and forecasting 1996 profits would be 15 percent down on 1995 due to the strong crown and weak markets.
Swedish Match rose 0.10 to 19.60 after posting a 15 percent fall in nine month pre-tax profit to 1.04 billion crowns.
Elsewhere on the market telecoms giant Ericsson rose 1.5 to 185 crowns.
